svg.aria-label: Fogg’s last breakfast — souvenir recipe card
svg.title: Fogg’s last breakfast — souvenir recipe card
svg.text: Reform Club, Wednesday 2 October 1872 — the meal before the wager
a scarlet slice of roast beef garnished with mushrooms,
and a morsel of Cheshire cheese, the whole being washed down
with several cups of tea, for which the Reform is famous.”
Reading sauce — James Cocks, fishmonger, Reading, from 1802; gone since the 1960s
broil the fish and spoon the sauce over.
Cook it on the evening of 21 December, and be at table by 8:45 pm.
Yunyou · Around the World in 80 Days · Day 1 London · vignette: London Interiors (1841), PD
